reason: I'd definitely use the free first visit, and if the kids like it I'd pay $13 once more, since the coffee is included and I get to sit. We'd go once or twice a month, so I'd never buy a membership, and I'd wait for a pack deal or coupon before spending more.
objection: We'd only go once or twice a month, so unlimited isn't worth it. At $13 a kid it adds up fast with more than one child, and there are free play spots around here.
would_change_my_mind: A Groupon or coupon deal, or a 5-visit pack that doesn't expire, would make me come back more often.
